raw_text: BREAKING: Wagner PMC has seized the Southern Military District HQ in Rostov-on-Don. Prigozhin filmed inside the building with Russian generals. Column continues north on M4. Russian Rosgvardia units reportedly stood down. This is the most significant internal Russian military crisis since 1991.
